'''2020 TMW Pods Brandon Baity DS I Want That Map''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Baity]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brandon Baity]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open I Want That Map Baity DS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
